name: Centrosomal microtubule anchoring and spindle orientation
rationale: All members concern centrosome positioning, MTOC microtubule nucleation/anchoring and cortical spindle positioning; spindle orientation and asymmetric division separate it from centrosome-maturation, tubulin-modification, ciliary and neuroblast-division neighbours.

core: Inherited cytochrome P450 and transporter defects
qualifier: hereditary spastic paraplegias and non-sterol phenotypes
name: Inherited P450 and transporter defects including hereditary spastic paraplegias
rationale: Every member is a monogenic disease caused by a defective P450 enzyme or membrane transporter, three of them spastic paraplegias, without the bile-acid, cholesterol-synthesis or eicosanoid/ichthyosis content of the neighbours.

name: Circulating monocyte surface marker and activation signatures
rationale: Members are monocyte/myeloid surface, receptor and differentiation signatures plus monocyte activation and myeloid chemotaxis control, lacking the dendritic-cell, TLR4 lineage, chemotaxis-extravasation or neutrophil-degranulation content of the confusables.

name: Pyrimidine and deoxyribonucleotide monophosphate catabolism
rationale: All members degrade (deoxy)nucleoside monophosphates, mostly pyrimidine, distinguishing them from pyrimidine biosynthesis/salvage and purine deoxynucleoside neighbours.

name: Chaperone refolding and aggregate control with nitrosative stress response
rationale: Members cover chaperone-driven refolding, inclusion/aggregate clearance and mitochondrial targeting control, with nitrosative and manganese stress responses that the HSF1 heat-shock, de novo folding and microautophagy neighbours lack.

name: Microglial activation and apoptotic cell engulfment
rationale: Members describe microglial differentiation, activation and cytotoxicity together with apoptotic-cell recognition and clearance, which separates the theme from the astrocyte, glial-apoptosis and amyloid-clearance neighbours.

name: ER membrane contact sites and interorganelle lipid transfer
rationale: Members concern ER tethering to mitochondria, plasma membrane and autophagosomes and phosphoinositide/phospholipid transfer between membranes, unlike the ER-tubule shaping and Golgi vesicle-traffic neighbours.

core: Fibroblast differentiation and connective tissue replacement
name: Cardiac fibroblast differentiation and fibrotic tissue replacement
rationale: All three members concern fibroblast/myofibroblast differentiation and connective tissue replacement in the heart, distinct from smooth-muscle switching, cardiomyocyte regeneration and TGF-beta wound-healing neighbours.

name: Replication-coupled nucleosome assembly and CHD1/2 remodeling
rationale: Members cover nucleosome organization, replication-dependent assembly, disassembly and chromatin targeting with CHD1/2 remodelers, whereas neighbours are BAF assembly or centromeric CENP-A deposition and acetylation.

qualifier: dendritic cell IL-12 and IFN-gamma induction
name: Dendritic cell IL-12 and IFN-gamma driven Th1 polarization
rationale: Members describe dendritic-cell cytokine and antigen-presentation activation, IL-12 and IFN-gamma production, MHC upregulation and Th1 differentiation, the upstream induction side absent from IFNG-signaling and IL-12 JAK-STAT/NKT neighbours.

name: Neural plate patterning and floor plate development
rationale: Members concern neural plate regionalization, neural fold formation, neuroepithelial fate and floor plate/ventral midline development, unlike the spinal neuron subtype and neural plate border/axis neighbours.

name: Ornithine–arginine metabolism and urea cycle regulation
rationale: Members cover ornithine, citrulline, arginine catabolism, aspartate metabolism, the mitochondrial ornithine carrier defect and transcriptional repression of urea cycle enzymes, not the core urea-cycle enzyme defects, glutamine/proline or arginine transport of the neighbours.

core: Postsynaptic receptor clustering and synapse assembly
name: Postsynaptic receptor clustering and neurexin–neuroligin synapse assembly
rationale: Members concern clustering of GABA-A/gephyrin and NMDA/PSD-95 at postsynaptic membranes and neurexin–neuroligin-driven assembly, distinct from neighbours built on other synaptic adhesion molecules, presynaptic assembly or LGI-ADAM.

name: Ionotropic glutamate and nicotinic receptor synaptic signaling
rationale: Members center on AMPA, kainate and nicotinic receptor activation and postsynaptic excitation with related channel modulation, whereas neighbours emphasize presynaptic glutamate release modulation or inhibitory clustering and vesicle exocytosis.

name: Glutamate, monoamine and acetylcholine release cycles
rationale: Members are the release cycles of individual transmitters plus synaptic vesicle docking, distinct from neighbours on general regulation of priming, SNARE assembly and calcium-dependent exocytosis.

name: Actin filament severing, bundling and filopodium regulation
rationale: Members concern actin severing, capping, crosslinking, parallel bundles and filopodium control (including EPHB and RHOF), unlike the lamellipodium, ruffle and motility-focused neighbours.

name: Urea cycle enzymes and inherited urea cycle disorders
rationale: All members are urea-cycle and arginine/citrulline synthesis steps or variants causing urea-cycle enzyme deficiencies, separating it from the ornithine catabolism, regulation and glutamate/glutamine neighbours.

name: Glycosylase-initiated base excision repair and its inherited defects
rationale: Members cover glycosylase recognition and cleavage, AP-site resolution and gap filling plus defective OGG1, MUTYH, NTHL1 and NEIL glycosylases, unlike the direct alkylation reversal and DNA demethylation neighbours.

name: Monoamine biosynthesis, oxidative degradation and sympathoadrenal development
rationale: Members cover catecholamine and serotonin synthesis, MAO/COMT degradation and adrenal/sympathetic noradrenergic development, whereas neighbours focus on BH4/dopamine synthesis or monoamine transport and uptake.

qualifier: CDK4/6–RB1 axis and its cancer defects
name: CDK4/6–RB1 G1/S control and its oncogenic defects
rationale: Members concern the p16/p14ARF–CDK4/6–RB1–E2F G1/S checkpoint, cyclin turnover and cancer variants that evade senescence, distinct from senescence induction, p53 transcriptional and G2/M neighbours.

qualifier: oxidised lipoprotein and foam cell formation
name: Scavenger receptor oxLDL uptake and foam cell formation
rationale: Members are scavenger receptor classes, immune complex and oxLDL uptake, lipoprotein signaling and foam-cell cholesterol storage, distinct from the apoptotic-cell clearance and lipoprotein-transport neighbours.

name: Osmotic stress and aldosterone-regulated sodium–potassium transport
rationale: Members regulate sodium/potassium transport, renal sodium handling and cellular osmotic and aldosterone responses, unlike neighbours defined by cation-chloride cotransporter and K-channel families or vasopressin–aquaporin water handling.

name: BAF and CHD chromatin remodeling with histone acetylation
rationale: Members cover BAF complex assembly, CHD1/2 remodeling, nucleosome organization and histone/protein acetylation, distinct from CENP-A deposition, CHD6-9/NuRD and stem-cell neighbours.

name: Fc-gamma receptor phagocytosis and inhibitory immunoreceptor signaling
rationale: Members cover FCGR activation, phagocytic cup formation, ADCC, hypersensitivity and inhibitory CD22/SIRP/Fc signaling, unlike neighbours centered on mast-cell FcεRI and BCR activation or neutrophil inflammatory responses.

name: Hematopoietic stem cell and thymocyte proliferation and survival
rationale: Members regulate HSC homeostasis and division, bone-marrow proliferation/apoptosis and immature thymocyte proliferation, survival and differentiation, distinct from neighbours on bone-marrow development, B-cell differentiation and thymic selection.
